title: Fix the ownership recovery follow-ups from the #999 review: comma module names, reserved delivery paths at no-spec approval, listing-bound silence, constraints renewal, registry specs, and directory scopes
description: Fix the ownership recovery follow-ups from the #999 review: comma module names, reserved delivery paths at no-spec approval, listing-bound silence, constraints renewal, registry specs, and directory scopes
acceptance_criteria: A no-spec-change draft listing a reserved delivery path approves; a comma-bearing module name never produces a non-round-tripping printed answer; an over-bound spec listing never silently omits an owner from recovery; ownership recovery re-prompts constraints when it clears them; a registry canonical spec outside specs_dir joins owner discovery; a directory scope with a source-like extension is not ownership-checked as a file

answers.constraints: Ownership gates from #986/#956 and the #999 review threads bound this work; lessons in specs/change/change.3md apply
